request.style: English, male solo voice with gospel choir, piano, organ, strings, drums, uplifting and solemn, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Abimelech and Phicol came to me
God is with you in all your deeds
Swear to me by God, do not lie
Show the kindness that you see

[Pre-Chorus]
I confronted him about the well
His servants took it, he denied
I gave him sheep and cattle too
And a covenant we made anew

[Chorus]
Seven ewe lambs I set aside
Witness that I dug this well
Beersheba, where we swore
God’s truth is clear and full

[Verse]
Abimelech asked what this means
These seven lambs from my hand
Accept them as my witness
That I dug the well in the land

[Pre-Chorus]
They returned to the Philistine land
Phicol and the king went away
I planted a tamarisk tree
And called on the Lord that day

[Chorus]
Seven ewe lambs I set aside
Witness that I dug this well
Beersheba, where we swore
God’s truth is clear and full

[Bridge]
The Everlasting God is my name
Called upon in the land of Canaan
Lived as a foreigner there
In His care and His plan

[Chorus]
Seven ewe lambs I set aside
Witness that I dug this well
Beersheba, where we swore
God’s truth is clear and full

[Outro]
Beersheba, the place of oath
Faithful is God in all truth
